name: logo-cloud
description: Strip of customer/partner/press logos for social proof. Defaults to text-based wordmarks (so a fresh scaffold renders cleanly without bundling real logos); users replace with their own image URLs.

ai.whenToUse: Use just below the hero on B2B sites — establishes trust early via 'as featured in' or 'used by'. Best with 4–8 logos. Text logos are stylized as wordmarks until users add real images.
ai.whenNotToUse: Don't use without real customers/press to show. Don't pad with random logos — fewer real ones beat more fake ones.

label.description: Small label above the logos (e.g. 'As featured in', 'Trusted by').

logos.description: Logos to display. Each declares `name` (wordmark text or alt for images), optional `src` (image URL — defaults to text wordmark), optional `href` (link out).
